work_items.title: JSONObject should safely truncate very large numeric strings
work_items.description: As an API consumer, I want JSONObject.optBigDecimal / put(String, Number) to handle extremely long numeric literals without throwing an unhandled ArithmeticException, so that malformed or adversarial input does not crash the parser.
work_items.acceptance_criteria:
- Parsing a JSON number with 1000+ digits does not throw an unhandled exception.
- JSONObject.optBigDecimal(key, default) returns the default value when the stored value cannot be converted.
- Existing valid numeric parsing behavior is unchanged for normal-sized numbers.

work_items.title: XML.toJSONObject should preserve attribute ordering for round-trip conversion
work_items.description: As a developer converting XML documents to JSONObject via XML.toJSONObject, I want attribute and child element ordering to be preserved deterministically, so that XML.toString(JSONObject) round-trips produce stable output for diffing and testing.
work_items.acceptance_criteria:
- Converting an XML element with multiple attributes preserves attribute order in the resulting JSONObject's internal ordering.
- Round-tripping XML -> JSONObject -> XML produces output with the same attribute order as the input.
- Existing XML parsing tests continue to pass.

work_items.title: JSONArray.toList() should deep-convert nested JSONObject/JSONArray values
work_items.description: As a consumer of JSONArray, I want toList() to recursively convert any nested JSONObject or JSONArray elements into plain Map/List structures, so that downstream code does not need to special-case JSON types when consuming array contents.
work_items.acceptance_criteria:
- JSONArray.toList() on an array containing a nested JSONObject returns a List where that element is a Map.
- JSONArray.toList() on an array containing a nested JSONArray returns a List where that element is a List.
- Primitive values (String, Number, Boolean, null) are preserved as-is.

work_items.title: JSONTokener should report accurate line/column numbers on malformed input
work_items.description: As a developer debugging malformed JSON input, I want JSONException messages produced during tokenizing to include accurate line and column numbers, so that I can quickly locate the offending character in large documents.
work_items.acceptance_criteria:
- Parsing malformed JSON with an unexpected character reports the correct 1-based line number.
- Parsing malformed JSON with an unexpected character reports the correct 1-based column number.
- Behavior for well-formed input is unaffected.

work_items.title: CDL (CSV) parsing should tolerate trailing blank lines
work_items.description: As a user of the CDL utility, I want CDL.toJSONArray to tolerate trailing blank lines in CSV input without producing spurious empty rows, so that CSV exported from common spreadsheet tools parses cleanly.
work_items.acceptance_criteria:
- CSV input with one or more trailing blank lines produces a JSONArray with no trailing empty JSONObject entries.
- CSV input with a blank line in the middle of the data is still treated per existing (documented) behavior.
- Header-only CSV input still produces an empty JSONArray without error.
